entity.title: End-to-end coverage
entity.description: What the e2e suite must cover, and how its harness is kept apart from the code under test.

rules.body: Every action.yml input and every APPROVE, POLICY and MERGE rule MUST have an e2e scenario or a stated exemption.
An e2e scenario MUST assert the decision and reason the action logged, not only the review it left or the absence of one.
The e2e harness, which holds the sandbox owner's token, MUST run only from the default branch of this repository.
The sandbox's caller MUST reference no secret other than the sandbox's own.
